Rabiya Salehjee is a full-stack software engineer with a Master of Science in Computer Science from Harbin Institute of Technology. She builds AI-integrated applications, interactive 3D web interfaces, Electron desktop applications, and real-time systems for production use.

## Summary

Rabiya has delivered production-grade software across web, desktop, and interactive environments. Her work spans enterprise dashboard systems, LLM-integrated desktop apps, WebGL-based 3D installations, and cross-platform real-time platforms. She is experienced in leading full ownership from architecture through deployment.

## Selected Projects

### Real-Time Multi-Screen Event Platform
A synchronized enterprise display platform with distributed state, playlist scheduling, and device orchestration across Linux, Windows, and macOS. Built with Electron, Socket.IO, STOMP, and TypeScript.

### Interactive 3D Installation Experiences
Browser-based 3D experiences combining custom particle systems, gesture recognition, and WebGL rendering for interactive installations. Built with Three.js, React Three Fiber, WebGL, and MediaPipe.

### HALO Data Cleaning System
A human-and-LLM-in-the-loop data cleaning workflow combining automated recommendations with user review for higher-quality datasets. Built with Python and LLM integrations.

### Fluencio
A public speaking improvement product with app and web interfaces for pacing analysis, filler-word feedback, and structured practice. Built with Java and speech analysis tools.
